messages:
Riley M.: Quick note re: end-of-cycle logistics — manager edits due Mon 2025-01-20 18:00 UTC. Were running staggered calibration panels over 48h to cover APAC/EU/NA. Please read the new triage flow below and sign up.

Jordan C.: Signup link: https://go/redwood/staggered-cal. Panels are labeled NA/M-EU/APAC. Pick the panel that matches most of your reviewers; if youre split, pick the timezone where the majority of your directs are.

Fiona Z.: New: calibration triage board (kanban) for late exceptions & split uploads: https://go/redwood/triage-board. If you submit after the deadline with an EXCEPTION tag, add a card to the board with the file name and brief reason. That helps the panel leads prioritize.

Priya M.: How should we flag hires with <14 days? We have 4 folks who started in the final two weeks.

Riley M.: Add HEADER TENURE=SHORT and include a one-line recommendation. These will default to the exceptions column on the triage board and receive light calibration. If you want full calibration, request it in the card comment.

Jordan C.: Contractors: same Manager Review Form but set CONTRACTOR=true in the header and include end_date. Contractors will not go into main calibration unless explicitly requested in the triage card.

Fiona Z.: Evidence expectations (paste into manager notes): one-line rationale per numeric rating; attach at least one artifact for ratings <=2; for PIP include PIP=true and attach start_date and improvement plan doc.

Priya M.: Delegation: managers can assign a delegate to submit during ingest. Add PROXY_SUBMIT=true and DELEGATE=<name,email> in header and attach a one-line manager sign-off in comments. We require a screenshot of Slack approval for audit.

Riley M.: New audit helper: when you set PROXY_SUBMIT, include MANAGER_SIG_TS=<iso> to speed verification. Multiple proxies OK but each manager needs a separate file.

Jordan C.: Anonymization: if you need peer feedback anonymized before calibration, set ANON_REQUEST=true and upload the redacted artifact to the secure folder (link in the signup page). Panel leads will be notified.

Fiona Z.: Import troubleshooting: if the bulk ingest throws mapping errors during the window, DM me a screenshot and the failing CSV slice. Ill run a small-batch reimport. To make that faster, include the header snippet and line numbers in the DM.

Priya M.: Are we still accepting split uploads for large spans-of-control?

Riley M.: Yes — set SPLIT_UPLOAD=true and PART=1 or PART=2 in the filename/header. Both parts must be present by the deadline. Mark the triage board card so leads know to wait for the partner file.

Jordan C.: Calibration slots (examples):
- Tue 2025-01-21 14:00 UTC (NA heavy)
- Tue 2025-01-21 19:00 UTC (EU overlap)
- Wed 2025-01-22 03:00 UTC (APAC friendly)
Pick one panel. If you have >10 directs, request a private panel and note it in the signup form.

Fiona Z.: Sample blurb managers can paste into Slack/email:

"Reminder: Manager edits due Mon 18:00 UTC. Use Manager Review Form v7 and attach evidence for any <=2 ratings. Tag PIPs, LOA, and transfers in the header. If you need a delegate during ingest, add PROXY_SUBMIT=true and include a one-line manager sign-off. See signup and triage board for exception handling: https://go/redwood/staggered-cal."

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Manager edits due Mon 2025-01-20 18:00 UTC" posted 2025-01-17 09:00 UTC. Reaction: :bell:

Priya M.: One last Q: payroll hold / comp-review candidates?

Riley M.: Tag HDR_FLAG=COMP_HOLD and include a brief note. Those records will be routed to payroll-review queue and excluded from main calibration. Add a triage card if urgent.

Jordan C.: Ill post the final pre-ingest checklist on Mon morning and close triage board additions 30m after ingest starts. Thanks all for coordinating — appreciate the attention to audit tags so we dont have to chase later. :heart:
